 nos.1 to 3.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicants Mohd. Arif, Mohd. Ishhak alias Ishhak Ahmed, Mohd. Irfan and Mohd. Zafar seek
anticipatory bail in Fir No.448 of 2024 dated 06.09.2024, under Section 420 Ipc, Police Station
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the informant supplied vegetables to the applicants under the assurance that the money would be given to the informant.
Money was given also, but entire payment was not made.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants would submit that it is a civil dispute.
5. The State as well as the informant to file objections.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing personal bond and two Mohd. sentences.text: (i) The applicants shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) They shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) They shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) They shall deposit their passports with the AO.
